narration.text: Still paying 300 pounds a month for AI video avatars?
At number five, we have HeyGen. It gives you one free minute of video every month. This is perfect for quick social media posts and testing out ideas without commitment.
Coming in at number four is DeepMotion. It lets you upload your own audio for perfect lip-syncing. This is fantastic for adding a personal touch to your avatar videos and keeping dialogue natural.
Number three is D-ID. You can generate five minutes of video from either photos or text. Imagine bringing an old photograph to life, or making your blog posts speak.
Our runner-up at number two is Colossyan Creator. It offers a library of diverse stock actors, free during your trial. This makes it easy to find the perfect presenter for any message or audience.
And the number one free AI alternative to Synthesia is Synthesys X. It is completely free, with no watermarks and unlimited downloads. It gives you professional results without any cost.
Synthesys X takes the crown for its unmatched value. Which free avatar maker is your favourite?
